Rajnath Singh outlines vision for self-reliant defence sector by 2047

Defence Minister Rajnath Singh has outlined a vision for India's defence sector to be self-reliant and strategically secure by 2047. He stated that the defence sector is a cornerstone of this vision. Singh also announced a policy push to deepen ties between the Defence Research and Development Organisation (DRDO) and the defence industry. This policy aims to provide Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSMEs) and start-ups with easier access to defence research and development capabilities.
